name: Samlip Co., Ltd.
summary: Samlip Co., Ltd. provides various food products in South Korea. It offers rice cakes, sandwiches, wheat flour, breads, sweets, noodles, frozen dumplings and pizza, bread crumbs, Jerry Po, eggs, dairy products, bottled water, ice creams, snacks, fruit products, ham, meat products, bacons, and sausages, as well as convenience and ready-to-eat food. The company provides its products under the SPC Samlip, Debt, Ta pio, Leopie, Minda Won, Grik Schwein, A snowy pasture, Egg Palm, Sanuki Borle, and Petrefomie brands. The company was formerly known as SPC Samlip Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Samlip Co., Ltd. in April 2026. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Siheung-si, South Korea. …
